title: Question
description: Core question contract (schemaVersion 1). The 'type' field is the extension point: new question types reuse this shape and only add fields, never change the meaning of existing ones.

id.description: Unique identifier within its exam. Must not be reused between questions of the same exam.

type.description: Question kind. single_choice and ayah are fixed in v1; the rest are reserved extension points.

prompt.description: The question text shown to the user.

options.description: Answer choices. Required for choice-based types and ayah.

correctAnswer.description: Correct answer. Expected shape depends on 'type' (see allOf below). Indexes are 0-based.

category.description: Top-level category id (see categories.json). Optional; used for filtering and scoring.

order.description: Display order within the exam. Optional; the array order is used otherwise.

reference.description: Optional source reference, reserved for Quran/ayah questions (e.g. { kind: 'ayah', surahId, verse }).

then.description: Reserved types. Exact answer shape is fixed when the type ships; existing files remain valid.
